steps.text: A cold wind whistles past my ears.
Down I fall, faster and faster.
But there is no end to this abyss.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: My crazy ideas? You're the only drummer I know who can actually make them happen.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You were the most hardworking drummer I have ever met.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: All you had to do... was be yourself, and nothing more.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You kept hopping from group to group, yet you never found a place to truly belong... Is this really the life you want?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You should never have had to bear this pain...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Umiri, let's get out of here. Together.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I will find you. I have to...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Uika...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, none of this is real. We need to...
BANG!
Her heart rate is ragged, her breathing is out of control, and her back is soaked with sweat.
Sakiko's consciousness has returned to her body once more, albeit in this most awful, unbecoming manner.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Felt real, didn't it?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Falling straight to the ground from who knows how high up.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, and then when the dream shattered and you were trapped in dreamless Limbo... how did that feel?

spans.text: Oh, and then when the dream shattered and you were trapped in dreamless Limbo... how did

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No matter how sweet those dreams were, they have to come to an end.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You pry into their most fragile parts and dramatize them over and over...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Must say, I don't agree.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Before you barged into their dreams uninvited, they'd all but forgotten about you and your insignificant little band.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ave{@nbs}Mujica is our contract. They entrusted their lives to me—

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You were the only one who ever cared about it!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What do you—?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Heard it for yourself, didn't you?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: One after another, they all rejected you.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Not a chance. Everyone here loves me for the actress I am.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I gave everything I had for this... and now you're telling me it's all fake?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: What a load of crap. I'm not accepting that!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: This is my dream, and I don't need anyone else in it, thanks!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: How can you possibly understand me?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: This lifestyle is perfect... It suits me better.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I don't need someone to save me.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: And no one could save me.

steps.name: 'Mutsumi'
steps.text: I knew it. Mutsumi-chan didn't need Sakiko.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hahahah-hah... Hah-hahahahah!!!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I got to see every one of your sorriest, most helpless, most laughable moments.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You may have destroyed the dreams I spun, but I suppose this makes us even.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And I have to thank you. You roamed their dreams again and again...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: In the process, proving to me that the dreamlands I wove were perfect, impeccable.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And now, even that pest ought to admit it. It's me. I'm the most talented of us all in the Castle of Dreams.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: 'Pest'?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Didn't you meet her in your dream?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: The snooty girl? Flowery high-nobility frock? All the outdated pleasantries?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Just being around her puts me ill at ease.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris is this place's master. You are nothing but a fraud!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: She said it! No matter how sweet the dream, one has to wake up in the end—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Nngh—!
Sakiko feels her vocal cords freeze in place. She cannot make even the slightest peep.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You know what? I finally understand why you get on my nerves so much.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You're just like her. You never listen to what others think. You just sit there spouting big, empty words forever.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You say they entrusted their lives to you, but let's be fair. You just don't want to be abandoned by others. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I've seen your life. There's not much to it. Just a princess's stubborn struggle after her fall from grace.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Each and every action of yours was done to deceive and persuade yourself, and to present yourself as never having fallen.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You're self-important, conceited, and an utter lost cause.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: What exactly does your band entail? Hmph. Just a bunch of girls using a so-called contract to bind one another for fun.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And now that they've all found happiness, of course they're abandoning you. Poor Sakiko Togawa. All alone once more.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: If you really believe what Iris said, then fine, I'll prepare another round of the sweetest dreams for you.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: It'll be perfect, impeccable. Realize it's a farce all you want, you still won't want to wake up.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Like your bandmates, you'll wallow in your dreams, unable to ever pluck yourself out.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Nngh—!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Something to say? Alright, you get one last time. Speak your mind.
The impish girl draws a pattern in the air, and there is a sensation of chains falling away.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I—
Then, the chains are pulled tight once again.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hahahah-hah-hah!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I knew it. You are much cuter when you're not talking!
As Sakiko struggles, Morpheus paces closer, step by step. Out reaches her right hand, and she places it on Sakiko's cheek.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: O ye, Princess of Hypocrisy. While you were on your dream tour, I've come to completely understand you as a person.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: What you thirst for the most, what you need the most, and what you fear the most.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: But don't worry. This dream? Will be absolutely perfect. You'll be more awake than ever. Not that you'll ever want to wake up.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now sleep, my noble, selfish, conceited little doll girl.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Sweet dreams.
Clank, clunk.
Sakiko? Sakiko!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mm... hmm?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I am NOT the kind of person you claim I—
Sakiko bursts out yelling, but she is no longer in the castle, and Morpheus is nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You okay? You look terrible. You have another nightmare?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I'm... back in my dream again.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: What are you talking about? Didn't you just wake up?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: What, you sleep so long your brain's fuzzy?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris and Bena are here...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Er, how do you do... I don't believe I introduced myself?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I think she was already asleep when we got on?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Vigna and I aren't late... The dream has changed...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Sakiko, you know, you keep saying some pretty weird stuff—

a.text: We are heading to a small town in Victoria to find a girl named Ann who is acquainted with Iris.
This vehicle will have a flat tire soon. We will be forced to get off to fix the tire, delaying us by a few hours...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are we going to Victoria to find Ann?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Who's Ann? Do you know, Iris?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I don't. Is that a friend of yours who lives there?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What...? You don't know her, Iris?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Then Vigna and I...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Uh, hello? We're on a field mission not too far away from your home. I figured I'd bring you back for a break, let you see your family.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You've been mega busy with work. Gotta be a while since the last time you went home, right?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: What's going on? Why did the car suddenly stop?!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Did a tire burst?!

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*... *pant*... Phew, we almost hit a burdenbeast!

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: That was close, but no worries. We can be back on the road right away!
As the engine starts humming again, the view outside the window begins to move once more.
The same wilderness, and the same companions.
That said, this dream is starting to bare its own colors.
